# Madrid

Madrid is a native macOS notes app for writing, linking, and searching personal notes.

- Website: https://getmadrid.app/
- Download: https://github.com/mrlemoos/madrid/releases/latest
- Source: https://github.com/mrlemoos/madrid
- Pricing: https://getmadrid.app/pricing
- Writing: https://getmadrid.app/writing
- Note graph: https://getmadrid.app/graph
- Offline and sync: https://getmadrid.app/sync
- Privacy: https://getmadrid.app/privacy

Madrid writes notes locally first. Signed-in subscribers can sync notes and attachments. Public product claims, pricing, and policies live on the URLs above.
